zh-CN.title: 聊天记录展示优化
items: 语音记录改为头像背景的轻量播放卡片，支持查看时长并快速跳回原消息
全部类型采用更紧凑的昵称与消息摘要排版，图片、视频、文件、位置、发言和活动信息更加清晰

en.title: Refined chat history results
items: Voice history now uses compact avatar-backed playback cards with duration and quick access to the original message
All results now use denser name-and-summary rows with clearer details for images, videos, files, locations, posts, and activities
